## Endpoints

### Data Read (5)
- `GET /api/community/popular` — Get a list of popular community items.
- `GET /api/projects/chats` — List available chat projects.
- `GET /homepage-widgets/manifest.json` — Retrieve the manifest for homepage widgets.
- `GET /rate-limit/generations` — Get the current rate limit for generations.
- `POST /{id}` — Update an existing variant with new data.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /api/chat/artifacts-preview` — Create a preview of chat artifacts.

### Core API (1)
- `GET /api/version` — Check the current version of the Variant API.
